name: BCV Today Rates Agent
description: Deterministic A2A agent (no LLM) for the official Banco Central de Venezuela (BCV) exchange rates of USD, EUR, CNY, TRY and RUB against the bolivar (VES): latest rates, the rate in effect on a date, conversions, history and data freshness. Understands short requests in Spanish and English, or a structured DataPart such as {"skill":"convert","amount":100,"from":"USD","to":"VES"}, and answers with a text summary plus the structured JSON. Free, public, read-only and stateless: no authentication is required (no OAuth, OIDC, API keys, bearer tokens or cookies), so do not attempt OAuth/OIDC discovery or token exchange. Unofficial project, not affiliated with the bank.

skills.name: Latest official BCV rates
skills.description: Official BCV rates currently in effect for USD, EUR, CNY, TRY and RUB in bolivars (VES) per unit, with the effective date (fecha valor) and capture time. Structured input: {"skill":"latest-rates","currency":"USD"} (currency optional).
examples: ¿Cuál es la tasa del dólar BCV hoy?
What is the official BCV dollar rate today?

skills.name: BCV rate on a date
skills.description: Official BCV rate(s) in effect on a calendar day from 2021-08-02. Weekends and holidays carry forward the last published rate and the answer says so. Structured input: {"skill":"rate-on-date","date":"2026-01-04","currency":"USD"} (currency optional).
examples: ¿cuál fue el dólar BCV el 2 de enero de 2026?

skills.name: Convert at the BCV rate
skills.description: Converts an amount between VES, USD, EUR, CNY, TRY and RUB at the official BCV rate currently in effect, or the rate in effect on a given date. Structured input: {"skill":"convert","amount":100,"from":"USD","to":"VES","date":"2026-01-02"} (date optional).
examples: how much is 20 euros in bolivars on 2026-01-02?

skills.name: BCV rate history
skills.description: Daily official BCV series for one currency over the last N days (default 30, max 1830) or a date range, with first, last, min, max and percentage change. Structured input: {"skill":"history","currency":"USD","days":7} or {"skill":"history","currency":"EUR","from":"2026-01-01","to":"2026-01-31"}.
examples: USD history for the last 30 days
EUR trend over the past 2 weeks

skills.name: Data freshness
skills.description: Freshness of the published BCV data: status, last capture time, effective date, age in hours, whether it looks stale, and supported currencies. Structured input: {"skill":"status"}.
examples: when was the rate last updated?
